events.text: Supreme Court hears Anderson v. Intel Corp. Investment Policy Committee.
events.detail: How ERISA’s duty of prudence applies when workers challenge retirement-plan investment options.

events.text: FOMC meeting minutes from the Sept. 15–16 meeting, 2:00 p.m. ET.
Evernorth / Armada II business combination expected to close (XRP-treasury SPAC).
events.detail: Shareholders approved Sept. 30; company says closing Oct. 7 subject to remaining conditions, with Nasdaq trading as XRPN expected Oct. 8. Closing is not guaranteed until conditions are met.

events.text: TOKEN2049 Singapore at Marina Bay Sands (crypto industry conference).
Treasury auctions $39 billion in 10-year notes (reopening), 1:00 p.m. ET.
events.detail: Comes days after the 10-year yield touched its highest level since 2002; demand at the auction is a direct read on appetite for long-term U.S. debt.

events.text: Evernorth Class A shares expected to begin Nasdaq trading under ticker XRPN.
events.detail: Depends on Oct. 7 closing; company projects ~473M XRP at closing if the deal closes.

events.text: Treasury auctions $22 billion in 30-year bonds (reopening), 1:00 p.m. ET.
Delta Air Lines reports September-quarter results; earnings call 10:00 a.m. ET.
events.detail: Usually the first big U.S. airline to report, and the first look at how higher jet fuel prices hit the quarter.

events.text: University of Michigan preliminary October consumer sentiment, 10:00 a.m. ET.
Supreme Court hears Beaird v. United States.
events.detail: Whether courts must still defer to Sentencing Guidelines commentary under Stinson v. United States.

events.text: JPMorgan Chase reports third-quarter results, kicking off big-bank earnings.
events.detail: Results due about 7:00 a.m. ET with an 8:30 a.m. ET call, per the bank. Citigroup, Goldman Sachs and Wells Fargo are also listed for Oct. 13 on public earnings calendars.

events.text: Supreme Court hears Salazar v. Paramount Global.
events.detail: How far the Video Privacy Protection Act reaches beyond traditional video providers.

events.text: September inflation (CPI) report, 8:30 a.m. ET.
September Producer Price Index (PPI), 8:30 a.m. ET.
Comment deadline on Treasury's proposed GENIUS Act stablecoin rules.
events.detail: Treasury's proposal sets how the GENIUS Act's limits on issuing, offering and selling payment stablecoins in the U.S. would work. Final rules come later.

events.text: Comment deadline on the SEC's proposed Regulation Crypto Assets.
events.detail: The proposal would add a safe harbor under which some crypto assets would not be treated as investment contracts under securities law. The SEC must still vote on a final rule.

events.text: Federal Reserve interest rate decision (meeting Oct. 27–28).
Q3 GDP advance estimate and September personal income/outlays (PCE), 8:30 a.m. ET.
Midterm elections.
October Employment Situation (jobs report), 8:30 a.m. ET.
Supreme Court hears the challenge to third-country deportations (date to be set).
events.detail: Deportations can continue in the meantime; a decision is expected by summer 2027.

events.text: Government funding deadline.
events.detail: Congress must pass funding or another stopgap by then to avoid a partial government shutdown.
